description: This file contains shell script code for testing date parsing and printing functionalities, including various test cases for different date formats, relative times, and edge cases. It makes use of external test libraries and testing functions to validate date conversions and representations.

methods.name: check_relative
methods.description: Tests relative date conversions comparing expected output for a given timestamp offset.

methods.name: check_show
methods.description: Tests the output of 'date show' for various formats and times, validating against expected strings.

methods.name: check_parse
methods.description: Validates the 'date parse' functionality with various date input strings and expected parsed output.

methods.name: check_approxidate
methods.description: Tests the 'approxidate' parsing function with natural language date expressions.

methods.name: check_date_format_human
methods.description: Checks the 'human' date formatting for relative times.
